:::{#thm-int-uniform-convolution}
#### Convolution of two uniform densities

Let $f(x) = \indic{[0, 1]}(x)$ be the indicator of the unit interval.
Then for every $x \in \reals$,

$$
(f * f)(x) = \int_{-\infty}^\infty f(t)f(x - t)\,dt
= \begin{cases}
x & \text{if } 0 \le x \le 1 \\
2 - x & \text{if } 1 < x \le 2 \\
0 & \text{otherwise.}
\end{cases}
$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-miller-int-uniform-convolution.

:::
